translations.web: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.
translations.bsb: For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing. They have no further reward, because the memory of them is forgotten.
translations.kjv: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
translations.asv: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not anything, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
